hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run typecheck >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'typecheck failed. Run: npm run typecheck — fix the errors before finishing.' >&2; exit 2; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && node cli/bin/groundwork.mjs detect . --fail-on P0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'The detector reports a P0 on this repo. Run: npm run detect — a tool that cannot pass its own checks is not evidence of anything.' >&2; exit 2; }
